description: This file contains the implementation of the SerializerConfigurationValidator class in C#, which validates serializer configurations in Orleans. It analyzes serializer availability, generates warnings or errors if issues are found, and helps ensure types used in grain interfaces are properly serializable.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A class that validates the serializer configuration in Orleans, checking for missing serializers or copiers and providing diagnostic messages.

methods.name: SerializerConfigurationValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with dependencies and determines if validation is enabled based on environment and options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs the validation of serializer configuration, analyzing serializer availability and throwing exceptions if issues are found.
